module.title: Medical Interventions, Surgery and Perioperative Care
module.business_purpose: Models medical interventions and operations from request and scheduling through preoperative assessment, surgical safety, anesthesia, operative execution, devices/implants/specimens, complications, recovery, follow-up, outcomes and charge linkage.
